name: Víctor Muñoz

career_stints.note: Primera Federación, 2742 minutes. Originally flagged as disputed (one source gave 34 apps/11 goals/7 assists, another 48 games/9 goals, another '10 goals as of May 2025') -- resolved 2026-08-09 via two further independent sources (besoccer.com, a separate web search), both corroborating 34 apps/11 goals/7 assists exactly. Treated as confirmed.
All-competitions totals, on loan/transfer from Real Madrid (€6m, confirmed July 10 2025). La Liga-only split: 34 apps, 6 goals, 2668 minutes. His full and only season before the Liverpool move.

Iraola's first Liverpool signing, summer 2026. No minutes played yet as of this profile's creation -- the genuine 'no prior-club-relative-to-Liverpool history' test case for the positional-logic rules.

notes: The one player of the original four-player priority list whose 'no Liverpool history' framing actually holds -- verified 2026-08-09. See BACKLOG.md's correction note re: Isak/Wirtz/Chiesa.

Only one professional season of starter-level data exists (Osasuna 2025/26) -- inherently a thinner individual prior than the other three players, by nature of being a fresh breakout talent rather than an established veteran. This is expected, not a data-collection gap.

Advanced per-90 metrics (shots, xG, pass accuracy, progressive passes, touches, duels won%) not found from an accessible source, including a direct attempt against his Opta Analyst (theanalyst.com) player page, which only showed his (all-zero) Liverpool 2026/27 stats, not his Osasuna history -- left null rather than guessed.
2026-08-09 follow-up: Castilla 2024/25 stats dispute resolved (see stint note above) via besoccer.com and an independent web search, both matching the 34/11/7 figure already used here.

Sources: realmadrid.com (official academy/debut announcements), espn.co.uk (Liverpool transfer report, Osasuna season stats), liverpoolfc.com, sportsdunia.com, bllog.co.uk, besoccer.com, theanalyst.com -- via web search 2026-08-09.
